title: Fix invalid ASSETCATALOG_COMPILER_GENERATE_SWIFT_ASSET_SYMBOL_EXTENSIONS value in Debug/Release Xcode configs (project.pbxproj)
rule: Tier-2 area note (drift between duplicated configs)
why: This is a Boolean Xcode build setting; 'AppIcon' is not a valid YES/NO value — it reads as a copy-paste bleed from the neighboring ASSETCATALOG_COMPILER_APPICON_NAME = AppIcon setting a few lines away. Debug and Release (the two configurations used for every local dev run and every shipped build) diverge from Profile, which has the correct YES. Currently inert since nothing in this small app consumes generated Swift asset symbols, but it produces an Xcode build warning today and will silently break (compiles only in Profile) the moment someone adds Swift code that references a generated asset symbol.
recommendation: Set ASSETCATALOG_COMPILER_GENERATE_SWIFT_ASSET_SYMBOL_EXTENSIONS to the same valid YES/NO value across Debug, Release, and Profile.
acceptance_criteria: All three XCBuildConfiguration blocks for ASSETCATALOG_COMPILER_GENERATE_SWIFT_ASSET_SYMBOL_EXTENSIONS use the same valid YES/NO value.
xcodebuild -showBuildSettings (or an xcodeproj lint script) shows no divergence between Debug/Release/Profile for this key.
deliveryHint: DELIVERY HINT (2026-07-20 tail cleanup, was PO-parked): current dev state — project.pbxproj has ASSETCATALOG_COMPILER_GENERATE_SWIFT_ASSET_SYMBOL_EXTENSIONS = YES in one XCBuildConfiguration and = AppIcon in the other two; 'AppIcon' is an INVALID value for this boolean key (looks copy-pasted from ASSETCATALOG_COMPILER_APPICON_NAME). Fix: set all three blocks to the SAME valid value — use NO (the app has no code consuming generated asset symbols; match Flutter's default) unless you find real consumers, in which case YES. ENVIRONMENT: this is Linux — xcodebuild is NOT available, so do NOT try to run it for AC2. Satisfy AC2 with a static lint instead: a checker/grep that parses project.pbxproj and fails if the three ASSETCATALOG_COMPILER_GENERATE_SWIFT_ASSET_SYMBOL_EXTENSIONS values diverge or are not a valid YES/NO. Ship it with a fixture proof (fires on divergence, clean after); wire into make audit if practical.
